pageTitle: "Fungus Mechanicus" Has Begun, Take Part in the Topic Event to Win Primogems
name: "Fungus Mechanicus" Has Begun, Take Part in the Topic Event to Win Primogems
description: Olah! Hello, Travelers~ Now that the "Fungus Mechanicus" event has begun, those familiar shroom buddies have returned to us once again. During your combat together, have you gained any unique insights? Which of them do you find most indispensable and trustworthy? Come and share your thoughts with us!
